content.short: WardenSwap is a multi-chain DEX that uses AI to find the best swap rates across multiple DEXes with low gas fees.
content.description: WardenSwap is a multi-chain decentralized exchange that uses an AI-powered algorithm to find the best swap rates across multiple DEXs. It operates on Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Cronos, Cosmos, Polkadot, Solana, and Base. Users can swap tokens with the lowest gas costs while earning a profit share of trading fees. The platform also offers an SDK, a UI kit, and the MetaWarden NFT, as well as bug bounty and partnership programs.
